description: Na₂SO₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (2.25 Å) and one longer (2.39 Å) Na-O bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.63 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.36 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.41 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.69 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.68 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four Na atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two S atoms.
